# Troublemaker [color=#d64700][italic]"Aren't you tired of being nice? Don't you just wanna go apeshit?"[/italic][/color]
Troublemakers are normal crew members who've just been pushed too far, and need to let off some steam with the oldest and most trusted form of stress relief - lashing out. Troublemakers are designed to be a [color=red]low to medium impact disruptive force[/color] on the station, and most importantly [color=yellow]want to keep their job at the end of their shift.[/color] Round Removal or mass killings are [color=red][bold]NOT[/bold][/color] the aim of the game here - dead people tell no tales, and Troublemakers want their frustrations heard.
Troublemakers start their shift with a [color=cyan]Smuggling Satchel[/color] full of goods from their life at home. They also start with a list of [color=red]objectives.[/color] These objectives, unlike the Syndicate Traitor, are [color=red]untracked[/color] - and can be used as prompts for what you COULD do, rather than what you MUST do.
Ultimately, a Troublemakers main goal is just that - [color=yellow]to make trouble on the station.[/color]
## Playing as a Troublemaker
Troublemakers play somewhat like thieves, in that they spawn with a [color=cyan]Smuggling Satchel[/color]. This will allow you to select two kits of predetermined items. Make your choice wisely, as you cannot get more bundles or kits. However, your objectives are formed in such a way that they can be achieved with your fists and words alone if you must. Try to make good use of your surroundings, as well as other people, or departments to get what you want to make your anger known to the world.
